mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_CHATMESSAGES_S ( chatroom_sq, sender_type, message_content, message_created_at
) VALUES ( #{chatroomSq}, #{senderType}, #{messageContent}, #{messageCreatedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT chatmessages_sq AS chatMessagesSq, chatroom_sq AS chatroomSq, sender_type AS senderType, message_content AS messageContent, message_created_at AS messageCreatedAt
FROM TBL_CHATMESSAGES_S WHERE chatroom_sq = ${chatroomSq} ORDER BY message_created_at ASC
